symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Only queue: they append an add or a clear request for an entity (and, for add, a spell) to the system's own pending arrays. The component is not touched at call time.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, OnDamageSpellsSystem::AnubisAddOnDamageSpell +0x122DBB0 and AnubisClearOnDamageSpells +0x122DCE0, both read: array appends through FUN_18122e1f0

does.text: Processes the two pending lists. For add requests it finds or creates esv::spell::OnDamageSpellsComponent on the entity through a get-or-create helper and puts the spell into its list; for clear requests it empties the list, and under a test that was not resolved (a bit in a set), RemoveComponentUnchecked removes the component (deferred). That the component therefore lives only while an entity has an on-damage spell is an inference: the remove's test and the add path are both unresolved.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, OnDamageSpellsSystem::UpdateOnDamageSpells at +0x122E420 (291 lines, read around the Remove and the helpers). Remove: RemoveComponentUnchecked(DAT_18226e66c & 0x7fff) at about line 205; DAT_18226e66c -> init +0x1C6890 -> 'esv::spell::OnDamageSpellsComponent'. The add goes through FUN_18122d0e0 (not an AllocRaw in its own body, so I cannot confirm it as ADD, only that it is the get-or-create path using the same type index)
